item.title: More lake-effect snow hits Chicago area Saturday, impacting travel and road conditions
item.description: Bursts of lake-effect snow continued to fall in the Chicago area on Saturday, impacting travel.

item.title: 2 shot during fight on CTA bus in Humboldt Park, Chicago police say
item.description: A 15-year-old boy and an 18-year-old man were shot Saturday during a fight on a CTA bus, Chicago police said.

item.title: 1 suspect in custody, another at large after Will County railway theft, car crash: sheriff
item.description: One suspect is in custody, and another is at large after a reported rail theft and car crash in Will County on Saturday morning, officials said.

item.title: Mayor Johnson directs Chicago police to investigate federal immigration agents' alleged misconduct
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson signed an "ICE On Notice" executive order directing Chicago police to investigate any alleged illegal activity by federal immigration agents, aiming to hold them accountable for any criminal misconduct.

item.title: Woman livestreams detainment as federal agents smash car window in SoCal: 'Lord, please protect me'
item.description: A woman who livestreamed her detainment by federal immigration agents is speaking publicly after she was released from custody Friday evening, describing the encounter as frightening and traumatic.

item.title: Thousands of runners brave snow, cold for F^3 Lake Half Marathon & 5K at Solider Field
item.description: Thousands of runners took on a challenge, braving the elements and bitterly cold temperatures while running along Chicago's lakefront Saturday morning.

item.title: 'Sanford and Son' star Demond Wilson dies at 79 after battle with cancer, son says
item.description: The entertainment world is mourning the loss of 70's TV star Demond Wilson, who was most known for his role opposite Redd Foxx in the hit series, "Sanford and Son."

item.title: ABC7 'Chicago Proud' streaming series showcases heartwarming, uplifting local stories
item.description: ABC7 is taking a look back at some of the most heartwarming and uplifting stories from across our area, along with the positive work so many Chicagoans are doing that truly make us proud of our hometown.

item.title: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker contributes $5M to super PAC supporting Lt. Gov. Stratton for US Senate
item.description: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker contributed $5 million dollars to a super PAC supporting his Lt. Governor Juliana Stratton, according to FEC records. She's one of multiple Democrats running for the U.S. Senate seat being vacated by Dick Durbin.

item.title: Highway 99 in Central California reopens after 59-vehicle pileup, CHP says
item.description: At least 10 people were injured the pileup, which occurred amid heavy fog and low visibility about 40 miles north of Bakersfield.
